card.name: Digits and qualifiers in consumer product text
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit or small word inside product, year or edition names in general web text, such as the 3 in 2013 Fishing Forecast. Also fires on a few scattered words like 'full', 'extra' and a possessive 's.

modes.label: Year or product number digit
modes.description: The last digit of a year or product code that is followed by a title or item name.

modes.label: Qualifier word before a noun
modes.description: A small modifier or marker in a product or offer description, just before a noun such as year or hour.

card.writes: It promotes list-like or markup-like tokens such as blanks, tags and trackers, with no tidy meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on the last digit of a year or product number in consumer web text, plus a few stray modifier words.
